findings.issue: Execution mapping could omit reviewed code or omit ENV/INPUT hashes.
findings.resolution: Required ENV_LOCK, INPUT_LOCK, CODE_LOCK document hashes and exact execution code mapping equality added; current source bytes also checked against implementation commit.

findings.issue: Acquisition could overwrite an existing non-pointer mismatched RF payload.
findings.resolution: Existing non-pointer mismatches now return BLOCKED_DATA and preserve bytes.

findings.issue: Dynamic extraction did not explicitly compare both archived range and signed s to clean raw extraction.
findings.resolution: Both range and signed s comparisons added with original stricter 1e-12 tolerance; clean lineage outcome remains conditional and visible.

verification_run.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_fp_sc_*.py -v

raw_scientific_verification_in_this_revi.claim: Code/spec and synthetic arithmetic review only. Actual input bytes are checked by the execution guard and will be rechecked by the separate result checker.

required_runtime_conditions: Implementation commit must contain every byte bound by this reviewed CODE_LOCK.
Exact owner-scoped E0 authorization must bind execution lock, this code review, and current input/environment/document hashes.
No E1-E5 or selector/SEALED work is authorized by this E0 verdict.
Any numeric mismatch must retain the failed run and original tolerances; E0 result acceptance remains separate.
Independent result checker must compare raw receiver results, archived r and s, no-op trace fields, oracle rows, counts and range statistics before a whole-E0 technical pass.
CIR and power relative arithmetic closure must be checked in the result audit in addition to absolute SI-unit source checks.
Current clean-reference validity is structural finite positive support only; it provides no noisy low-power safety claim.
